checks.scope: Actual unchanged compiled app/worklet and normal UI confirmation. Token endpoint and WebSocket peer are injected. Next microphone input is an explicitly labelled local tone, not ASR evidence.

speech.validation: Every metadata and WAV hash checked read-only; no synthesis on worker/--live paths, no old speech manifest or freeze overwritten.

pacing.clock: Browser elapsed clock, bound from observed confirmed receipt, never reset by polling/synthesis.
tested: ACK request with no reply.started and late old reply.done stays pending
Own correlated cancelled/interrupted reply may drain without a final transcript
Tool result requires normal post-result continuation, with or without ACK
Actual playback must drain before next synthetic input
Missing ACK expires once; an older ACK cannot conceal newer expiry
System receipt never counts as typed user input
Pre-submit timestamps/history stay separate from the new player turn

authorization.boundary: Attachment presence is not approval. This task used GAME_DISABLE_LIVE=1 only.

limitations: Constructed peer/tone tests do not prove real ASR, model comprehension, physical speech/audio or Voice Rescue.
The existing 450 ms quiet window does not guarantee against arbitrarily late provider events.
Observed request/reply metadata is not a provider context-ingestion ACK.
Prior full-suite/failure/media/accounting evidence remains unchanged; separately accepted execution requires its own activation freeze/admission.
